annotations.title: Find drillholes by place, owner and type

description: Use when the user asks which drillholes there are in a place or of a company or project (WA open-file and company collars). Filter by a bbox or a point and radius, and/or a company or project key from search_tenement_holders; drilling type groups (dd = diamond core, rc = RC, ac = aircore and RAB, shallow = vacuum, auger, costeans, percussion..., other); a minimum depth; drilled years. Returns the count, counts by hole type and by decade, the holes sorted by depth, deepest first (holeid, type, depth, year, operator, project, lon/lat), and a map link showing them. Assays and traces come from get_drillhole_traces or sql_query.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees; at most 25 square degrees.

company.description: A company key from search_tenement_holders, e.g. "NORTHERN STAR".

project.description: A project key from search_tenement_holders, e.g. "jundee".
